meta.title: Connect Gmail to Claude (and any AI)
meta.description: Connect Gmail to Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client in one click with Google OAuth. Let AI read, send, schedule and organize your Gmail — inboxes and tool calls free.

hero.titleLine2: and Cursor, ChatGPT, any MCP client
hero.lead: Give your AI agent a real Gmail inbox in minutes. Read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize mail with one-click Google sign-in — and use the same inbox in every MCP client, not just one.

method.title: How Gmail connects: one-click Google OAuth
method.body: Gmail connects with Google OAuth — sign in with Google, approve read and send access, and you're connected. No app password, no IMAP settings to dig up. Revoke access anytime from your Google account or the mcpemails dashboard.

verificationNote.title: Heads up while Google verification is in progress
verificationNote.body: mcpemails is currently in Google's verification and CASA security review. Until it completes, Google shows a “Google hasn't verified this app” screen — click Advanced, then Go to mcpemails.com to continue — and the connection needs reconnecting roughly every 7 days. Both go away once verification lands.

caps.title: A Gmail inbox your agent can actually use
caps.sub: Nine action-based MCP tools — not just drafts. Your agent finishes the job inside Gmail.

capabilities.p: List, read and search across labels — find that invoice, summarize a thread, or pull the latest from a sender.
Compose and send real messages, reply in-thread, and forward — directly from Gmail, not as a draft you finish by hand.
Queue a message to go out at the right time, so your agent can draft now and send on schedule.
Keep the inbox tidy — apply labels, archive what's handled, and delete on request.

how.title: Connect Gmail in three steps
how.sub: From sign-up to first AI email in a couple of minutes.

steps.p: Sign up for mcpemails — no card required. The free plan gives you unlimited inboxes and tool calls.
Click Connect Gmail, sign in with your Google account, and approve read and send access. No app password or IMAP setup.

steps.h: Paste the MCP URL into your AI
steps.p: Drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the inbox.

ctaBand.title: Give your AI a Gmail inbox
ctaBand.sub: Connect Gmail in minutes — unlimited inboxes and tool calls on the free plan, no card required.

meta.title: Connect Fastmail to Claude (and any AI)
meta.description: Connect Fastmail to Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client with an app password. Let AI read, send, schedule and organize your Fastmail — inboxes and tool calls free.

hero.titleLine2: and Cursor, ChatGPT, any MCP client
hero.lead: Give your AI agent a real Fastmail inbox in minutes. Read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize mail with a single app password — and use the same inbox in every MCP client, not just one.

method.title: How Fastmail connects: an app password
method.body: Fastmail connects over IMAP/SMTP using a Fastmail app password — generate one in Fastmail under Settings → Privacy & Security → App passwords, paste it into mcpemails, and you're connected. No OAuth dance, no browser pop-ups.

caps.title: A Fastmail inbox your agent can actually use
caps.sub: Nine action-based MCP tools — not just drafts. Your agent finishes the job inside Fastmail.

capabilities.p: List, read and search across folders — find that invoice, summarize a thread, or pull the latest from a sender.
Compose and send real messages, reply in-thread, and forward — directly from Fastmail, not as a draft you finish by hand.
Queue a message to go out at the right time, so your agent can draft now and send on schedule.
Keep the inbox tidy — file mail into folders, flag what matters, archive the rest, or delete on request.

how.title: Connect Fastmail in four steps
how.sub: From sign-up to first AI email in a couple of minutes.

steps.p: Sign up for mcpemails — no card required. The free plan gives you unlimited inboxes and tool calls.
In Fastmail, go to Settings → Privacy & Security → App passwords and create one for mail (IMAP/SMTP).
Add your Fastmail address and the app password to connect the inbox securely.

steps.h: Paste the MCP URL into your AI
steps.p: Drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the inbox.
